summary: The agent wrote the Dockerfile, compose.yaml and RUN.md for P6, and a single deploy_check run passed, with /health returning 200 and the log showing the app on port 8080. Nothing failed, but the health check ran only once and no build or compose run appears in the tool list, so you may want to confirm the image builds and the stack starts before approving. The compose file publishes the port on 127.0.0.1 only, which is worth a glance if you expected it to be reachable from other machines.
